title: 第2章 圣剑套牌第3章 遇袭第4章 激战
content_zh:
第二章 圣剑套牌
“呼…………”
而直到这时，罗德才长出了口气，重新躺了回去。
经过刚才和少女的聊天，罗德已经可以确认，这的确是龙魂大陆的世界。而且，这并不是自己之前所经历的时代，更是更加遥远的过去———暮光之年，换算成游戏时间的，也就是龙魂大陆游戏刚刚开始公测的时期。
自己怎么会来到这里的？
罗德叹了口气，他摇了摇头，不再去去想这些古怪神秘的事情，无论如何，自己已经来到了这里，这已经是一个事实了。那么接下来，自己该做些什么？
首先，罗德先决定尝试一下自己目前能够做什么。而他只是转念一想，很快，眼前就浮现出了一条清晰熟悉的系统提示，上面显示的，正是他目前的状态及属性：
种族：混血（？？）
天赋：未解封
种族奖励：未解封
种族特性：未解封
职业：召唤剑士（英雄职业）
职业技能：唤灵术（熟练度E）
持有剑术：月影剑术（熟练度E）（可用技能—破碎之刃）
兼职：炼金术士（奥秘造物专长）
持有技能：凝神形塑（熟练度E）
这是非常正常，又非常不正常的属性表，特别是在看到第一项的时候，罗德就差点叫出声来。
混血？怎么会是混血？
在龙魂大陆上所谓的混血，并不是指类似地球什么人种之间的通婚混血，相反，一般具备有混血这个属性的，大多都是人类与人类以外的种族通婚才会产生的。但是罗德很清楚，自己是人类，而且就算是在游戏中的玩家角色，他也没有选择其他的种族。但是为什么现在，自己的属性表上却会多出一个混血？而且后面是括号中的问号，则是代表血脉还没有完全觉醒，因此种族奖励和种族特性也是被封印的。这就代表罗德必须自己明白自己拥有着什么样的血液，并且唤醒血脉中沉睡的力量之后才能够获得。
这对于罗德来说可以算是一个麻烦，因为一般的种族奖励是人物建立之后就会提供的。象人类的种族奖励是学习技能的时间缩短，并且按照人种还会有抗毒，提升声望等等不同的加成。但是现在，这些奖励和特性与罗德就已经绝缘了。

但是也并非没有惊喜，因为在剑术和炼金术那一栏，罗德发现除了自己一级的必备技能之外，自己在身为玩家时所学习的那十几种剑术以及炼金技能并没有被遗忘，而是安静的陈列在下面，不过它们都是暗色的，这表示以罗德目前的能力和等级，还无法学习和使用它们，不过这倒不用罗德担心，只要他的实力提升，到达条件之后，那么就可以再次获得这些剑术和技能的使用权。当然，唯一美中不足的就是这些剑术和技能的熟练度也被还原成为了最低的E级，而不是SS级。
不过罗德并没有把这些小事放在心上，因为他最看重这些技能不是因为它们的熟练度，而是它们的来源，有很多剑术是相当难学的，不仅仅是需要等级提高或者属性，很多时候要完成一系列的任务，或者提升自己的声望，又或者仅仅只是巧合寻找到了隐藏物品。这些都需要大量的金钱，时间甚至是运气。而在游戏之中，直到罗德在龙魂大陆的最后一年，他才彻底完全的打造好了自己的角色，也因此才有了挑战虚空之龙的把握。
可惜，有喜有忧，剑术方面的问题得到了解决，不过罗德很快就发现，自己被清零的不仅仅是经验，等级和熟练度。还有对于召唤剑士来说最重要的存在———召唤精灵。
在龙魂大陆这个游戏中，召唤剑士是个饱受争议的职业，一开始的时候，它是作为官方推出的，玩家专属职业而受到众人的关注。但是在真正上手之后，召唤剑士却因为它魔武双修导致两头不沾边的半截子属性，以及需要召唤精灵配合攻击的复杂程度，还有在升级过程中对于经验值的消耗三方面而被玩家称之为最坑爹的职业之一。
从字面上来看，召唤剑士的召唤术和法师的召唤术似乎毫无区别，但是事实上两者之间是截然不同的，法师的召唤术是通过消耗自己的力量，撕裂空间，召唤亚位面的生物，利用魔法的威力强行制约住它们来为自己服务。而召唤剑士则不同，他们没有撕裂空间位面的能力，他们所有的召唤物全部来自于现世。而其中一项能力便是通过召唤剑士独特的“唤灵术”，可以从那些历史悠久，充满神秘与灵魂力量的物品上重新唤醒它们的灵魂，并且借由契约的模式将它们重新封印使用。
虽然听起来很好很强大，但是这其中的麻烦却也不少，事实上一开始很多玩家都被这个技能所迷惑而选择了召唤剑士，在他们看来，只要在遗迹中或者商会里用低价买回一些破损的上古物品，然后利用唤灵术将那些武器的灵魂呼唤出来封印，然后自己就可以不费吹灰之力的得到一把神器。
可惜的是梦想很美好，现实很残酷，先不说上古级别的武器残骸只有高阶唤灵术才能够激活其沉睡的灵魂，而且身为灵魂体的它们由于失去了物质形态，因此力量也远比本来的时候要弱很多。就拿罗德在游戏中曾经所使用的准神器“龙王之怒”来说，也是他在满级之后，才从一件武器残骸里提取出了灵魂，但是那时候所凝结的武器甚至威力还远不比锻造大师所制造出来的同级武器强大，之后罗德花费了整整两年时间，在整个龙魂大陆上东奔西跑，上天入地之后才好不容易重新激活了那把武器上所有碎片的灵魂，并且使其重新恢复了原状，先不说时间，单单是过程中的凶险，也足以让不少人望而却步。更何况精灵武器在使用过程中是需要消耗灵魂力量来维持的，而召唤出来的精灵也同样需要灵魂力量的消耗，但是召唤剑士本身所储备的灵力远远不比法师，因此很多召唤剑士最终宁可选择普通的武器，也不会使用这种“看起来很美”，但是事实上却没太大帮助的精灵武器。
而除此以外，召唤剑士的精灵来源还有三种，一是拿到魔力生物死亡之后所凝结的灵魂之核来唤醒，并且使其成为自己的召唤精灵。但是这会因为持有者本身的属性，以及环境等方面原因的影响而产生变化。打个比方来说，如果一个召唤剑士在杀死一条火蛇时得到了灵魂之核，但是他却是在冰天雪地或者其他环境下，又或者穿着黑暗属性的装备时唤醒灵魂的话，那么保不准最终呼唤出来的会是个什么属性的怪物。如果是拥有黑暗力量的九头蛇还好，但是如果是那种因为属性相克而减弱能力的普通魔怪的话，那么就只有哭去了。
而第二种获得召唤精灵的方法，就是打败那些非人生物，在满足了一定的条件之后，也同样可以和它们签订契约，将它们封印起来作为自己的召唤精灵来使用。这也是召唤剑士比较普遍的方式，但是缺陷则在于这种召唤生物的自主性太强，如果是在游戏中的话，那么表现就是有可能会根据自己的判断来反抗其召唤者的命令。想当然，这也不会受到什么人的欢迎，毕竟谁都不想自己召唤出来的东西还越帮越忙的。
至于最后一种方法就是在十级之后唤醒属性调整天赋，通过将数个召唤精灵融合，来产生更加高等的精灵，这个方法在一定程度上到是控制了召唤精灵本身的不确定性，只要熟悉召唤精灵的特征，种族，属性，那么对于它们融合之后会变成什么样的召唤精灵大多也会心里有数。但是这种方式的缺陷也同样坑爹———那就是新产生的召唤精灵等级是不定的，有可能会出现将两只高等级召唤精灵融合，结果产生了一只1级的新召唤精灵，也可能会融合出一个比持有者等级高的多，根本无法使用的召唤精灵。如果是后者还好，只要努力提升自己等级就行，如果是前者的话，那么你就删号吧……
召唤精灵的经验是从持有者的身上扣除，这也是为什么召唤剑士比其他职业升级都要慢的主要原因，同样的经验值，其他职业只需要顾及自己就好，但是召唤剑士却必须要分出来给自己的召唤精灵进行提升，而这个度却很难掌握，分配经验给自己的召唤精灵，可以保证提升它的等级，在到达一定程度之后进化，但是正如同第一点所说的，精灵在进化时会受到当时环境，持有者意志以及外界影响等等变化，因为有时候进化出来的召唤精灵并不一定是持有者想要的召唤精灵。
而也正因为召唤剑士的这种种“坑爹”的特性，使得它也在龙魂大陆的官方论坛上“众望所归”的荣登“十大最坑爹职业之首”，有人则很形象的给了召唤剑士操纵者们一个评价，玩召唤剑士的人，要么是那种根本没有玩过游戏，被介绍和CG宣传骗进来的菜鸟。要么就是那种不求上进的休闲玩家。在来就是那些生姓爱拼人品赌博的赌徒。而最后一种就是……罗德。
单从这个游戏ID从单纯的名字变化为一种现象的代言，就可以得知当罗德以召唤剑士这个被举世公认坑爹无比的职业身份取得了无数个服务器第一，甚至还连续征服了三个新时代时，那些玩家心里是什么样的感觉。
一般的玩家不喜欢这种太过随机的方式，这会让他们有一种不在自己掌握中的感觉，但是罗德却乐在其中，正因为未知，所以才有挑战性，这也是他选择了召唤剑士这个职业的原因。事实上，在漫长的游戏生涯中，所有召唤剑士的“坑爹”表现他几乎都遇到过，但是罗德却乐此不疲，因为只有征服这样的困难，才会让他更有满足感。
但是现在，他花费了整整七年时间，培养出来的数十只顶级召唤精灵，全部被清除，右手背上那个神秘的召唤法阵依旧存在，但是在其中，罗德已经感受不到任何精灵的踪影了。不过转念一想倒也难怪，自己这个身体毕竟不是游戏中的身体，也不能够强求太多。
不过……
想到这里，罗德不由内心一动，随后他伸出手去，摸向自己的胸前口袋，果然，他很快就摸到了一张卡牌。
那是一张白底色的卡牌，上面所描绘的，是一把被荆棘所缠绕，通体洁白无暇的长剑，上面雕刻着复杂繁华的雕文，护手处则是一对正在收拢的精美翅膀，仅仅只是看上去就给人一种赏心悦目之感，在牌面的四个角度部分，有着四种不同的标记，在右上角的，是一个白色的半圆，而在左上角则写着一个小小的X，再往下望去的话，左下角与右下角则有两个小小的数字——3。翻过牌去，一道神秘，优雅的文字缓缓的在卡牌背面浮现。
[永恒圣剑第十位：星痕，无属性，可融合———历史的尘埃也无法掩埋它那夺目的光辉]
居然还在？

望着手中的这张卡牌，罗德微微一愣，这正是召唤剑士的专属装备，召唤卡牌。而且这一张他还非常熟悉，这是自己曾经参加游戏中活动时官方所送给自己的稀有卡牌纪念品，在他率领公会连续两个季度获得全服务器第一之后，为了表彰这位强悍无比的顶级玩家，游戏公司特意为他制作了这么一张卡牌。当然，类似的卡牌周边早就多的海了去了，但是对于罗德而言，他倒没有那个闲心把钱浪费在这些只能够看不能够用的东西上，所以他手上也只有这张奖品，当然，罗德是拿到以后，是把它作为护身符带在身边的，反正也不占什么地方。
原本这只是一张普普通通，除了数量为全世界只有一张之外非常普通的纪念奖品而已，但是此刻，罗德却看见它的表面正散发出微弱的光亮，在自己的手中闪耀。
要试试看吗？
罗德只是犹豫了一秒，随后，他的右手便握紧卡牌，接着，附着在罗德右手背上的魔法阵忽然亮起，一道道湛蓝色的魔法线条从中扩散出来，延伸到右手的每一根手指上，接着，白色的卡牌猛然暴发了耀眼的白光，随后便化为点点光尘，彻底消失在空气之中。
而此刻，罗德的眼前也浮现出了一条系统提示。
[已获得永恒套牌1/10，永恒圣剑第十位—星痕]
“呼………”
注视着这条系统提示，罗德有些复杂的叹了口气，虽然不知道为什么在原本世界里只不过是普通卡牌的东西到了这里却发挥出了召唤卡牌原本的功能，但是对于现在的罗德来说，这绝对算是目前最有用的助力———在游戏中，十五级之前能够找到+2能力的武器都很罕见，而“星痕”居然拥有着初始+3的属性，这足以让原本呈半废物状态的召唤剑士与正牌剑士相比。再加上它的可融合特性，也就意味着只要找到合适的精灵，就可以使其变化为属性武器。虽然作为召唤卡牌必须让持有者消耗灵魂之力才能够使用的特点让它和正常的武器比起来有些逊色，但是仅仅凭借攻击力来说，它已经算是现时少有的强力装备了。
只不过现在的罗德实在很难彻底兴奋起来，因为对他来说，自己所卷入的这个状况，实在是太诡异了。
这是游戏？还是现实？如果这是现实的话，那么自己又该何去何从？
“咚咚。”
就在这时，敲门声响起。
罗德抬起头来，正好看见一个中年男子推门走进来，他穿着冒险者的皮甲，一头鲜红的长发随意的向后梳理着，看见罗德，男子微微一笑。
“你好，先生，我是星月佣兵团的团长，卡特。”

Chapter 2 Holy Sword Deck
"Huh..."
It was only then that Rhodes took a deep breath and lay back down again.
After chatting with the girl just now, Rhodes can confirm that this is indeed the world of Dragon Soul Continent. Moreover, this is not the era that I have experienced before, but the more distant past - the twilight years. When converted into game time, it is the period when the Dragon Soul Continent game just started its public beta.
How did you get here?
Rhodes sighed, shook his head, and stopped thinking about these weird and mysterious things. In any case, it was already a fact that he was here. So what should you do next?
First, Rhodes decided to try what he could do now. But he just changed his mind and soon, a clear and familiar system prompt appeared in front of him. What was displayed above was exactly his current status and attributes:
Race: Mixed(??)
Talent: Unblocked
Racial rewards: not unlocked
Racial Traits: Unblocked
Occupation: Summoning Swordsman (Heroic Occupation)
Occupational Skill: Evocation (Proficiency E)
Swordsmanship held: Moon Shadow Swordsmanship (Proficiency E) (Available Skill—Broken Blade)
Multiclass: Alchemist (Arcane Creation feat)
Skill held: Concentration Shaping (Proficiency E)
This is a very normal and very abnormal attribute table. Especially when he saw the first item, Rhodes almost screamed.
Mixed race? How could it be mixed race?
The so-called mixed blood in Dragon Soul Continent does not refer to the intermarriage between human races similar to that on Earth. On the contrary, those with the attribute of mixed blood are mostly the result of intermarriage between humans and races other than humans. But Rhodes knew very well that he was a human being, and even as a player character in the game, he did not choose another race. But why is there an extra hybrid on my attribute table now? And there is a question mark in parentheses after it, which means that the bloodline has not been fully awakened, so the racial rewards and racial characteristics are also sealed. This means that Rhodes must understand what kind of blood he has and awaken the sleeping power in his blood before he can obtain it.
This can be considered a trouble for Rhodes, because general racial rewards are provided after the character is established. The racial reward for humans is that the time to learn skills is shortened, and there are different bonuses based on the race such as poison resistance, reputation improvement, etc. But now, these rewards and characteristics are insulated from Rhodes.
But it was not without surprises, because in the column of swordsmanship and alchemy, Rhodes found that in addition to his first-level essential skills, the dozen swordsmanship and alchemy skills he had learned as a player had not been forgotten, but were quietly displayed below, but they were all dark, which meant that with Rhodes' current ability and level, he could not learn and use them. Of course, the only flaw is that the proficiency of these swordsmanship and skills has been reduced to the lowest E level instead of SS level.
However, Rhodes didn't take these little things to heart, because he valued these skills most not because of their proficiency, but their origin. There are many sword skills that are quite difficult to learn. They not only require level improvement or attributes, but also often require completing a series of tasks, or improving one's reputation, or just finding hidden items by coincidence. These require a lot of money, time and even luck. In the game, it was not until Rhodes' last year in the Dragon Soul Continent that he completely crafted his character, and therefore had the confidence to challenge the Dragon of the Void.
Unfortunately, there are joys and sorrows, the swordsmanship problem was solved, but Rhodes soon discovered that it was not just his experience, level and proficiency that had been cleared. There is also the most important existence for the summoned swordsman - the summoned spirit.
In the game Dragon Soul Continent, the summoned swordsman is a controversial profession. At the beginning, it was officially launched as a player-exclusive profession and attracted everyone's attention. However, after actually getting started, the Summoned Swordsman was called one of the most deceptive professions by players because of its inconsistent attributes due to its dual cultivation of magic and martial arts, the complexity of summoning elves to coordinate attacks, and the consumption of experience points during the upgrade process.
From a literal point of view, there seems to be no difference between the Summoning Swordsman's Summoning Technique and the Mage's Summoning Technique, but in fact the two are completely different. The Mage's Summoning Technique consumes his own power, tears apart space, summons subplane creatures, and uses the power of magic to forcibly restrain them to serve himself. The summoning swordsmen are different. They do not have the ability to tear apart the space plane. All their summons come from the present world. One of the abilities is to summon the swordsman's unique "Spirit Summoning Technique", which can reawaken the souls of items with a long history, full of mystery and soul power, and re-seal them for use in the form of a contract.
Although it sounds good and powerful, there are also a lot of troubles involved. In fact, many players were confused by this skill at first and chose to summon swordsmen. In their opinion, as long as they buy back some damaged ancient items at low prices in ruins or chambers of commerce, and then use the spirit summoning technique to call out the souls of those weapons and seal them, then they can get an artifact without any effort.
It's a pity that dreams are beautiful, but reality is cruel. Not to mention the remains of ancient-level weapons. Only high-level spiritual summoning techniques can activate their sleeping souls. Moreover, as soul bodies, they have lost their physical form, so their power is much weaker than before. Take the quasi-artifact "Wrath of the Dragon King" that Rhodes once used in the game. He extracted the soul from the remains of a weapon only after he reached full level. However, the power of the condensed weapon at that time was far less powerful than the weapons of the same level created by the blacksmith master. Later, Rhodes It took a full two years, running around the entire Dragon Soul Continent, going to heaven and earth, to finally reactivate the souls of all the fragments on the weapon and restore it to its original state. Not to mention the time, the danger of the process alone was enough to deter many people. What's more, elf weapons require the consumption of soul power to maintain during use, and the summoned elf also requires the consumption of soul power. However, the spiritual power reserved by the summoned swordsman itself is far less than that of the mage. Therefore, many summoned swordsmen would rather choose ordinary weapons in the end than use such elf weapons that "look beautiful" but are not very helpful in fact.
In addition, there are three sources of spirits for summoning swordsmen. One is to awaken the soul core condensed after the death of a magical creature, and make it your own summoned spirit. However, this will change due to the attributes of the holder itself, the environment and other factors. For example, if a summoned swordsman obtains the soul core when killing a fire snake, but he awakens the soul in ice and snow or other environments, or while wearing dark attribute equipment, then there is no guarantee of what attribute monster will be summoned in the end. It would be okay if it was a Hydra with dark power, but if it was an ordinary monster whose abilities were weakened due to conflicting attributes, then you would have no choice but to cry.
The second way to obtain summoned spirits is to defeat theSome non-human creatures, after meeting certain conditions, can also sign contracts with them and seal them to use as their own summoned spirits. This is also a relatively common way to summon swordsmen, but the drawback is that this kind of summoned creature is too autonomous. If it is in a game, it may rebel against the orders of its summoner based on its own judgment. Of course, this will not be welcomed by anyone. After all, no one wants the thing they summoned to be more and more helpful.
As for the last method, you can awaken the attribute adjustment talent after level ten, and fuse several summoned elves to produce a higher-level elf. This method can control the uncertainty of the summoned elf itself to a certain extent. As long as you are familiar with the characteristics, race, and attributes of the summoned elf, then most of them will have an idea of ​​what kind of summoned elf they will become after fusion. But the flaw of this method is equally deceiving - that is, the level of the newly generated Summoned Elf is uncertain. It is possible that two high-level Summoned Elf will be fused, resulting in a new Level 1 Summoned Elf, or it may be fused to create a Summoned Elf that is much higher than the holder's level and cannot be used at all. If it's the latter, that's okay, just work hard to improve your level. If it's the former, then just delete your account...
The experience of the Summoned Swordsman is deducted from the holder, which is the main reason why the Summoned Swordsman upgrades slower than other professions. For the same experience value, other professions only need to take care of themselves, but the Summoned Swordsman must separate it to upgrade his Summoned Elf, and this speed is difficult to master. Distributing experience The Summoned Elf you give yourself can guarantee that it will improve its level and evolve after reaching a certain level. However, as mentioned in the first point, the Elf will be subject to changes in the environment, the will of the holder, external influences, etc. during evolution, because sometimes the evolved Summoned Elf is not necessarily the Summoned Elf that the holder wants.
And it is precisely because of the "cheating" characteristics of the Summoned Swordsman that it was also "popularly expected" to be ranked among the "Top Ten Most Cheating Professions" on the official forum of Dragon Soul Continent. Some people vividly gave Summoned Swordsman operators an evaluation. People who play Summoned Swordsman are either rookies who have never played the game at all and were tricked into it by introductions and CG promotions. Or he's the kind of casual player who doesn't seek advancement. Here are those gamblers who love gambling based on their character. And the last one is... Rhodes.
Just from the fact that this game ID has changed from a mere name to an endorsement of a phenomenon, we can know how those players felt when Rhodes won the first place in countless servers as a Summoning Swordsman, a professional identity that is universally recognized as a cheat, and even conquered three new eras in a row.
The average player doesn't like this too random method, which makes them feel like they are not in their control, but Rhodes enjoys it. It is precisely because of the unknown that it is challenging. This is why he chose the profession of Summoning Swordsman. In fact, in his long gaming career, he has encountered almost all the "cheating" performances of Summoned Swordsmen, but Rhodes never tires of it, because only conquering such difficulties will make him more satisfied.
But now, the dozens of top-level summoning elves he spent seven years cultivating have all been cleared away. The mysterious summoning circle on the back of his right hand still exists, but Rhodes can no longer feel any trace of the elves in it. But after thinking about it, it's no wonder. After all, my body is not the body in the game, and I can't force too much.
But...
Thinking of this, Rhodes couldn't help but feel something in his heart. Then he stretched out his hand and touched his breast pocket. Sure enough, heI quickly drew a card.
It was a card with a white background. What was depicted on it was a long sword that was entangled with thorns and was completely white. It was engraved with complex and prosperous glyphs. On the hand guard was a pair of exquisite wings that were being folded. Just looking at it gave people a pleasing look. To the eye, there are four different marks on the four angles of the card. In the upper right corner, there is a white semicircle, and in the upper left corner, there is a small X. If you look down, there are two small numbers in the lower left and lower right corners - 3. Turning over the card, a mysterious and elegant text slowly appeared on the back of the card.
[Eternal Holy Sword No. 10: Star Trace, no attributes, fusion--the dust of history cannot bury its dazzling brilliance]
Still there?
Looking at the card in his hand, Rhodes was slightly startled. This was the exclusive equipment of the Summoning Swordsman, a summoning card. And he is very familiar with this card. It is a rare card souvenir given to him by the official when he participated in in-game activities. After he led the guild to win the first place in the entire server for two consecutive quarters, in order to commend this extremely powerful top player, the game company specially produced such a card for him. Of course, there are already a lot of similar cards around, but for Rhodes, he doesn't have the leisure to waste money on these things that can only be seen but not used, so he only has this prize in his hand. Of course, after Rhodes got it, he carried it with him as a talisman, and it didn't take up much space anyway.
Originally this was just an ordinary commemorative prize, except that there was only one in the world. But at this moment, Rhodes saw that its surface was emitting a faint light, shining in his hand.
Want to give it a try?
Rhodes only hesitated for a second, and then he clenched the card with his right hand. Then, the magic circle attached to the back of Rhode's right hand suddenly lit up, and blue magic lines spread out from it, extending to every finger of his right hand. Then, the white card suddenly erupted with dazzling white light, and then turned into specks of light dust, completely disappearing into the air.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared in front of Rhodes.
[Obtained 1/10 of the Eternal Deck, the 10th Eternal Holy Sword—Star Trace]
"Huh..."
Looking at this system prompt, Rhodes sighed with some confusion. Although he didn't know why something that was just an ordinary card in the original world came here to play the original function of a summoning card, but for Rhodes now, this is definitely the most useful help at present - in the game, it is very rare to find weapons with +2 ability before level 15, and "Star Trace" actually has an initial +3 attribute, which is enough to make the Summoned Swordsman who was originally in a semi-waste state compared with the real swordsman. Coupled with its fusion characteristics, it means that as long as you find a suitable elf, you can transform it into an attribute weapon. Although as a summoning card, the holder must consume soul power before it can be used, which makes it somewhat inferior to normal weapons, but in terms of attack power alone, it is already considered a rare powerful equipment nowadays.
It's just that it's hard for Rhodes to be completely excited now, because for him, the situation he is involved in is really weird.
Is this a game? Or reality? If this is reality, then where should I go?
"Dong dong."

Rhodes raised his head and saw a middle-aged man pushing open the door and walking in. He was wearing an adventurer's leather armor and his long bright red hair was combed back casually. When he saw Rhodes, the man smiled slightly.
"Hello, sir, I am Carter, the leader of the Star and Moon Mercenary Group."
